notes: Spec commit cd78fb38e819de77d9b527d110476eccb876f1bd, version 2026-08-25. Doc reorg: docs/specification/order.md -> docs/specification/shopping/order/index.md; docs/specification/order-rest.md -> docs/specification/shopping/order/rest.md.

Schema paths for the order area did NOT move: source/schemas/shopping/order.json and source/schemas/shopping/types/{order_line_item,adjustment,expectation,fulfillment_event,order_confirmation}.json all stayed at their 04-08 relative paths (only the shared error/message-envelope and other common value types moved into source/schemas/common/types/ in this release). All order-area required[] blocks verified byte-identical, several at the exact same line numbers as 04-08.
All 33 rows classified CARRIED — every 04-08 order requirement has a direct, verbatim (or near-verbatim) equivalent in 08-25. Zero RENAMED, zero REWORDED (strict sense), zero DEAD.

One row (ORD-007) has a lightly expanded sentence in the new doc ('Quantities are signed step counts and amounts are signed—...' vs 04-08's 'Quantities and amounts are signed—...'), driven by the new quantity_unit/scale contract introduced elsewhere in 08-25's Data Model section; the normative claim (signed, negative=reduction, positive=addition) is unchanged, so it was kept CARRIED rather than reworded, with the diff called out in its notes for reviewer visibility.
One row (ORD-014) has an expanded (not renamed) scope-table description; the scope identifiers dev.ucp.shopping.order:read / dev.ucp.shopping.order:manage are unchanged.

order.json gained new optional fields not present in 04-08 (label, policies, messages, attribution) and its totals/policies/messages properties now $ref shared types under ../common/types/ — none of this affects the carried required[] rows (ORD-003/004) and no new rows were added for these optional fields per the fixed 33-row scope of this pass.
